name: web-collapsible-sidebar-layout-with-icon-nav-and-main-content
title: Bare app shell: left sidebar with icon-and-label nav (Home, Inbox, Calendar, Search, Settings), a collapse toggle and a main content area
whatItIs: A white layout with an 'Application' label and five thin-line icon items in a left column separated by a hairline, a small panel-toggle icon at the top of the main area and a bold 'Main Content' heading with one line of text.
whatItMeans: Neutral and functional; nothing but structure so any content can be dropped in.
techniques: Pair line icons with labels in a vertical list.
Separate sidebar from content with a hairline.

vocabulary.definition: The persistent frame of navigation around content.
A button that hides or shows the sidebar.
An icon drawn with thin strokes.
